provenance:
ADR-033 §g, the

-typeset family and the ONLY filing in 38 whose cover carries no registrant-name caption at all. Microsoft FY2013 10-K, fixture already committed for msft-2013-content/structure/blocks/table. Cover region is normalized_text[0:6369), zero elements. The cover reads 'Commission File Number 0-14278 MICROSOFT CORPORATION WASHINGTON 91-1144442 (STATE OF INCORPORATION) (I.R.S. ID)': no '(Exact name of registrant...)', no '(Address of principal executive offices)', no '(Registrant's telephone number)', and the state/EIN captions self-abbreviated to wordings that appear nowhere else in the corpus. registrant_name is therefore the POSITIONAL path (ADR-033 §b3) at BASE_WEAK 0.75 -- the non-empty line between the commission file number and the EIN-pivot line -- and this case is the only place that path is exercised. It is deliberately NOT resolved at 0.95: a 1-in-38 positional guess that reads as confidently as a caption match is the dishonesty ADR-018 §1 was written against. state_of_incorporation still resolves at 0.95 because the EIN pivot does not care that the caption is abbreviated.
